Resolution No. 2016-42 establishing a no parking zone during specified times on the north side of Cereus Street and the west side of Hermes Avenue. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Blough
Staff recommends that Council adopt Resolution No. 2016-42 establishing no parking zones on the following streets: 1) North side of Cereus Street between the hours of: 7:30 a.m. - 8:30 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m., Monday through Thursday of school days only; 7:30 a.m. - 8:30 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. - 1:30 p.m., Friday of school days only; and 2) West side of Hermes Avenue from the north line of Cereus Street southerly for a distance of 140 feet between the hours of: 7:30 a.m. - 8:30 a.m. and 2:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m., Monday through Thursday of school days only; 7:30 a.m. - 8:30 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. - 1:30 p.m., Friday of school days only.

Contact Person: Senior Planner Sapa'u (REPORTS ARE LARGE AND MAY TAKE A MINUTE OR TWO TO LOAD)
Deny the appeal, and adopt draft Resolution No. 2016-56 (Attachment CC-1) affirming the decision of the Planning Commission to certify the Environmental Impact Report (EIR) and approve the project. Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
